SASBDB entry SASDAK6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDAK6/)

Xylose (glucose) isomerase, Streptomyces rubiginosus (tetramer, 184 kDa), extrapolated to infinite
dilution (1.2-12.83 mg/ml) in PBS, 50 % glycerol, 0.076 M NaCl, pH 7.4, no temperature given (25 C assumed);
EMBL X33, DORIS III; project "Standard proteins". No publication is listed by SASBDB.
Files, all from SASBDB (https://www.sasbdb.org/rest-api/entry/summary/SASDAK6/) except 1OAD.pdb:
  experimental_data/SASDAK6.dat    media/intensities_files/SASDAK6.dat (q in nm^-1)
  SASDAK6_fit2.fit                 media/fitting_files/SASDAK6_fit2.fit (CRYSOL layout, q in A^-1)
  SASDAK6_fit2_model1.pdb          media/pdb_file/SASDAK6_fit2_model1.pdb (atomic "assembly" built
                                   from PDB 1OAD: tetramer, 12 266 records, with the crystallisation
                                   ligands MPD, MRD, MQD, TRS, Mg, Mn; no hydrogens)
  1OAD.pdb                         RCSB asymmetric unit (two chains), kept for comparison.
SASDAK6 has two fits: fit1 DAMMIF (chi2 2.158; not used) and fit2 the atomic assembly (chi2 2.048;
used). The .fit header says "Chi:1.431" = sqrt(2.048): the header is a chi, the REST value the
chi2; the script uses 2.048.
The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDAK6/ states the conditions it takes from the entry;
there is no paper. PBS recipe: Cold Spring Harb Protoc 2006, pdb.rec8247.
